notes.title: New Building Additions and Material Updates
notes.content:
We are happy to share with you our latest progress update and upcoming additions to the game! As we continue to work on refining the inventory and production chains, we are also expanding our range of buildings. Your feedback has been crucial in shaping our development.

[h3]New Building Materials[/h3]
As part of our ongoing efforts to enhance your gaming experience, we're currently updating the materials used for buildings within the game. These improvements aim to create a more engaging and visually appealing environment, showcasing the depth and detail of the world we're building together with your input.

[previewyoutube=4zuZBA4lEDI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The Poll[/h3]
Recently, we asked for your input on the optimal number of functional buildings in the game, and we received an amazing response from 80 participants. Here's a summary of the results:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42128985/a4428298e9469f6bf8178f82e3630a4d327421a2.jpg[/img]

50 players preferred 10-20 functional buildings (is the currently planned number)
17 players favored 20-40 buildings
3 players expressed a desire for more than 40 functional buildings in the Early Access version

We are working hard to make the game the best it can be, and while we've made significant progress, there's still more work to be done. As we mentioned earlier, there will be a delay before the testing rounds begin, but rest assured that the extra time and effort we put in will be worth the wait. 

Stay tuned for more updates and information as we move closer to the testing rounds. In the meantime, feel free to share your thoughts and suggestions in our community forums and/or [url=https://discord.com/invite/uZbcqzCN2y]Discord[/url]. 
Together, we can create an awesome game. 🥳

notes.title: Raise and Tame Your Lightning Dragon
notes.content:
[h2]It is electrifying![/h2]
Here comes the newest addition to your dragon team - the lightning dragon!
[previewyoutube=XfiOoEeaFIw;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can probably imagine, this dragon breathes lightning-like fire and we've worked to make the particle effects reflect that. Its wings also sizzle with electricity, and the tip of its tail can shoot dangerous lightning bolts when attacked.

[previewyoutube=xA9k4Zu1wzM;full][/previewyoutube]
Tame and raise your baby dragons. They are cute and cuddly when you spend enough time with them. If you feed and care for them, you'll see them grow into magnificent creatures. But most importantly, when they are tamed, they will always be ready to protect you and your citizens.


[h2]New Boss Creature[/h2]
We've also been working on this Cyclops Viper, a snake-like creature and monster boss that will certainly be a challenge for you. Adult vipers are also known to be a threat to dragon eggs!

[previewyoutube=KaJ_gL_5F4I;full][/previewyoutube]

Test your skills and see if you can take it down to get some unique loot! With its speed and tricky moves, this snake-like monster is sure to keep you on your toes.

Thanks for your interest in Guild of Dragons and for being a part of our amazing community. 
Please don’t hesitate to ask questions here or on [url=https://discord.link/guildofdragons]Discord[/url].

If you haven't done so already, please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1462260/][b]wishlist [/b]and [b]follow us[/b][/url] to get all updates and info.

notes.title: Building on Steeper Slopes & More Languages
notes.content:
It's time for a quick update.
 
[h2]Building placement on steeper slopes[/h2]
In the past few weeks, we have revised the building placement system. Now it is possible to place buildings even on relatively steep slopes because the terrain now adjusts accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42128985/adee07a8f8f539acbc749ce73c61f64d962bd17a.gif[/img]

[h2]More Languages[/h2]
We have decided to translate Guild of Dragons into additional languages.
First of all, we translated our Steam page and of course, the text in the game will be available in these languages as well: In addition to English and German, the following languages will be available:
[list]
[*] Japanese
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Portuguese (Brazil)
[*] Polish
[*] Russian
[*] French
[*] Spanish
[/list]
[h2]Work in progress[/h2]
We are also working on a new dragon, the modeling is already done, so now we start painting it, then comes the rigging and animation part. We will keep you updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42128985/dab9f99f5a0e973ff31198eaf747b4404a5dc763.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42128985/9ab81fc836fcd87265d33fbb4ad0af5f934c293c.jpg[/img]

There is a lot of coding being done at the moment, which is not that exciting visually, but very important to make sure the alpha version is ready in September.
 
Thanks for your interest in Guild of Dragons and for being a part of our amazing community.

Your game developers
